def find_markers(text):
    s = "" if text is None else str(text)
    m_added = re.search(r"added", s, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    if not m_added:
        return None
    m_due = re.search(r"due", s[m_added.end():], flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    if not m_due:
        return None
    due_start = m_added.end() + m_due.start()
    due_end = m_added.end() + m_due.end()
    return s, m_added.start(), m_added.end(), due_start, due_end

def drop_one_leading_space(t):
    if t and t[0] in (" ", "\u00a0", "\t"):
        return t[1:]
    return t

def candidates_for_segment(raw):
    seen = []
    for cand in (raw, drop_one_leading_space(raw), raw.lstrip(" \u00a0\t")):
        if cand not in seen:
            seen.append(cand)
    return seen

def parse_sentence(text):
    found = find_markers(text)
    if not found:
        return "", "", ""
    s, add_start, add_end, due_start, due_end = found
    name_raw = s[:add_start]
    added_raw = s[add_end:due_start]
    due_raw = s[due_end:]
    return name_raw, added_raw, due_raw

def parse_date_2021(value):
    txt = str(value).replace("\u00a0", " ").strip()

        txt = f"{txt} 2021"
    txt = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", txt)

def split_sentence(s):
    s = "" if s is None else str(s)
    added = re.search(r"Added", s, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    if not added:
        return "", "", ""
    due = re.search(r"Due", s[added.end():], flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    if not due:
        return s[:added.start()], s[added.end():], ""
    due_start = added.end() + due.start()
    due_end = added.end() + due.end()
    name_part = s[:added.start()]                 # preserve the separator before "Added" (NBSP in the sample)
    added_part = s[added.end():due_start]
    if added_part[:1] in (" ", "\u00a0", "\t"):   # match the worked example: no leading separator
        added_part = added_part[1:]
    due_part = s[due_end:]
    return name_part, added_part, due_part

def parse_2021_date(text):
    txt = str(text).replace("\u00a0", " ").strip()
    if not re.search(r"\b\d{4}\b", txt):
        txt += " 2021"
    txt = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", txt)
    for fmt in ("%d %b %Y", "%d %B %Y", "%b %d %Y", "%B %d %Y"):
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(txt, fmt)
        except ValueError:
            continue
    return txt
